title: Fixed Paired Clamp Carriage and Tracing Disk Machine
description: One newly authored complete static bench key-duplicator-style machine exterior, with empty clamps and no key geometry. A chamfered low case on four finite pads supports one shared horizontal axle and complete wide sleeved carriage. Two full open-front clamp bodies have genuine empty lower-to-upper-pad gaps, separate smooth upright spindles and plain knobs. The rear right raised case carries one short fixed spindle, a thick toothless chamfered disk and a real open lower/forward guard web and curved rim; the independently shaped rear left bracket carries one blunt forward tracing stem. A full sloping carriage lever and whole grip complete the shared machine. This entire paired-clamp-carriage, separate tracing station and single guarded disk relationship is new, not the old bench grinder with one wheel deleted or the old opposed-centre lathe renamed. No previous model vertices or components are imported. One prop, zero scenes and no separately counted clamp or accessory. Four opaque untextured constant PBR roles, metres, native Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred ground datum. Static occupational display only: no key or usable bitting profile, teeth, sharp blade, working copying mechanism, calibration, tracing fidelity, carriage motion, rotation, clamping, cutting, electrical operation, lock bypass, manufacturing guidance, ergonomics, stability or machinery-safety claim. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made and are outside the static delivery.
